claims.statement: The splitter is focusable and fully operable by key.
The splitter is the shared resize primitive, not a second implementation of one.
Orientation maps straight through to the resize axis, so a grid splitter needs no separate component.

component.purpose: Two panes and one splitter, in either orientation, composed from the shared resize primitive.
component.title: SplitPane

states.description: Side-by-side panes with a vertical splitter.
